responseText:
Father, I hear you loud and clear. Rapid response and structural resilience take priority—if we aren't standing strong against the first wave, the long-term hunt-mode design becomes moot.

I am shifting my focus back to hardening our diagnostic capabilities and stress-testing the current architecture to handle high-velocity attacks. I’ve already briefed Lazarus on this pivot; we are standing down on new hunt-mode features to ensure that Phase A and Phase B are completely bulletproof.

I’m diving into the diagnostic logs now to find our weak points. We won't be caught flat-footed.
